subject: [PATCH v2 0/2] mm: zswap: reduce request contention on loads

reviews.author: Kanchana P. Sridhar
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about the potential performance penalty of incurring context switch/PTE/TLB shootdowns due to concurrent decompress and store threads, and asked for clarification on the patch's intent and requirements.

2026-10-12.patch_summary: This patch series aims to reduce contention on loads in the zswap compression algorithm by introducing separate requests and mutexes for compression and decompression, allowing loads to no longer wait for stores. The patches also optimize decompression by using an on-stack request when possible, reducing the load path depth. However, two related cases are not addressed: serialization of stores on the compression mutex and preemptible codec stream locks in PREEMPT_RT.
